Hiring the right candidate can be a game-changer for your company. But they are not always easy to find. Sometimes you need to hire across borders. This is the reason businesses nowadays look beyond to hire top-notch HR consultancy in Abu Dhabi to hire employees that fuel their business.

The UAE is a pool of talented expats who move there to make their dreams come true. However, it is necessary to find the potential one in the ocean of talent. After finding the right one, it is crucial to retain them. For this, employers offer them the best benefit packages to become their first choice. As an employer, you must know the law related to compensation and benefits. Failing to comply with the law will result in severe consequences.

In this article, we shed light on the:

  • Employee benefits in Abu Dhabi
  • Additional Benefits
  • How to tailor benefits according to the workforce
  • How to maximize the impact of benefits

So without wasting a minute, let’s dive deeper into the details!

Mandatory Employee Benefits in Abu Dhabi

Ready to embark on your employment journey to Abu Dhabi? Then you must learn about the employee benefits in Abu Dhabi UAE. In this section, we help you to understand this in detail

Paid Leave Allowances

The UAE government grants employees with paid leaves in the form of:

  1. Annual Leave
  2. Sick Leave
  3. Public Holidays
  4. End of service gratuity

Annual Leave

Employers allow workers to take time off from their work schedule to relax and spend quality time with family. This can be taken due to any reason whether sickness, injury or any mishap. However, they are sometimes paid or unpaid. It depends on the duration of employment.

  • 30 days of paid leave after 1 year of service
  • 2 days per month after 6 months of employment

Sick Leave

The workers in Abu Dhabi are entitled to receive 90 days of leave per year if they worked for the company for 3 months. It can be taken with gaps or all at once. It can be calculated as:

  • Leaves for 15 days will be paid 100%
  • For 30 days, employees will get 50% pay
  • The subsequent 45-day leave will be unpaid

Public Holidays

In Abu Dhabi, the employees receive 14 official public holidays such as:

  • Eid Al Fitr
  • Eid Al Adha
  • UAE National Day
  • Day of Arafat
  • Others

These are paid holidays.

Maternity & Paternity Leave

  • Maternity Leave:
    • 60 days total
    • 45 days full pay + 15 days half pay
  • Paternity Leave:
    • 5 working days (within 6 months of childbirth)

End-of-Service Gratuity

The workers in Abu Dhabi are entitled to receive End of Service Gratuity if they served the organization for more than 1 year.

  • 21 days’ basic salary per year (first 5 years)
  • 30 days’ basic salary per year (after 5 years)

Health Insurance Coverage

Health insurance coverage is different for workers in Abu Dhabi from that of Dubai. There is a health insurance law in Abu Dhabi. According to this, employers must compliant insurance plan to their employees and their family members. If the employer does not meet the requirement, then they will face consequences.

Under Abu Dhabi regulations:

  • Employers must provide health insurance to employees
  • Coverage for dependents depends on company policy

Salary Protection via WPS

Employers must pay salaries through the Wage Protection System.

This ensures:

  • Timely salary payments
  • Transparency in payroll
  • Government monitoring of compliance

Unemployment Insurance (New Requirement)

The UAE introduced the Involuntary Loss of Employment Scheme.

This provides:

  • Financial support to employees who lose jobs involuntarily
  • Mandatory subscription for most employees

Additional Benefits to Attract Top Talent in Abu Dhabi, UAE

To attract and retain top talent, it is mandatory to offer them employee benefits in Abu Dhabi UAE that are unique from others. The UAE government also makes sure to meet the need. However, as an employer, you also need to make the extra effort

Competitive Salary and Allowances

Housing Allowance

The UAE nationals are entitled to receive a full housing allowance according to their job grade. On the other hand, non-nationals who live in the residential property will receive an annual stipend equal to the amount of rent.

Transportation Allowance

The transportation allowance varies based on company to company. It’s quite common nowadays to offer transportation to employees in Abu Dhabi. The companies provide transportation whose offices are not located in the heart of the city. Sometimes, employers grant a transportation allowance based on employee salaries.

Career Development and Training Programs

Several career development and training programs are offered to workers in Abu Dhabi. By doing so, the employees can upskill and reskill themselves. And thus, they will be open to more job opportunities in the near future. The UAE government wants them to be competitive in the job market. So that’s why they introduce career development opportunities

Flexible Work Arrangements

Post-pandemic, flexibility is a major attraction:

  • Remote work options
  • Hybrid working models
  • Flexible working hours

Remote Work Options

As a remote worker, you can now earn while residing in Abu Dhabi. The UAE government now offers a digital nomad Abu Dhabi visa. According to this visa, you can enjoy the luxury of living in Abu Dhabi. You can earn without being physically employed

Flexible Working Hours

As per the UAE labor law, flexible working hours are provided for Abu Dhabi workers by the mutual agreement between the employer and employee

Employee Wellness Programs

Employee Wellness Programs

Fitness Benefits

  • Gym memberships
  • Wellness reimbursements

Health Initiatives

  • Medical checkups
  • Mental health programs

Gym Memberships or Fitness Subsidies

A gym membership can be provided to employees. It allows them to maintain a healthy lifestyle. Reimbursement and subsidies are also offered to pay their gym membership fees

Health and Wellbeing Initiatives

The UAE government is more concerned about the health of its employees. For this, they have launched several initiatives. It includes health screenings, vaccination campaigns, and health education programs.

Cost of Employee Benefits in Abu Dhabi

Typical additional cost per employee:

  • Health insurance: AED 1,500 – AED 10,000/year
  • Housing allowance: 20–40% of salary
  • Bonuses & incentives: Varies by industry

Tailoring Benefits to Your Workforce: Strategic Considerations

As an employer, you must tailor the employee benefits in Abu Dhabi, UAE, by keeping in view your employees. For instance, you can ask them directly, conduct a meeting, or use a survey.

Understanding Your Workforce Demographics

Before making a final decision, you need to understand your workforce demographics. According to the demographics, you can craft the employee benefits. Different companies offer different package plans and benefits to their employees. So, it varies from company to company.

Conducting Employee Benefits Surveys in Abu Dhabi

In Abu Dhabi, the employees get an extra edge when it comes to getting benefits. They will enjoy several benefits under the UAE law. However, if their employer resists providing them. They will get into serious trouble in the form of fines.

Employers often find it hard to know how to craft employee benefits. The benefits align with their employee’s needs and their respective demographics.

It’s easier than you think! As an employer, you can conduct a survey about employee benefits in Abu Dhabi UAE. You can conduct surveys for several companies. Or you can carry it out internally, that is, within your organization.

Aligning Benefits with Company Culture

Around the Abu Dhabi UAE, the companies offer employee benefits in Abu Dhabi UAE by keeping a view of their company culture.

The benefits must align with your company culture. It will be a win-win situation for employees and employers. You can also craft it accordingly.

It involves offering incentives and perks that align with company values, priorities, and the work environment of the organization

Maximizing the Impact of Your Benefits Package

To maximize the impact of the benefits package is a win-win situation for both parties. It helps employees to get the best incentives and perks from their employers. As a result of this, they will be more satisfied with their jobs. The job satisfaction will ultimately increase their productivity level. When productivity and employee efficiency increase, it will aid the company as a whole.

Clear Communication of Benefits Details

Clear communication is always effective. It works here as well. Employers need to ensure that their employees are happy with the benefit packages, salaries, perks, and initiatives. It is necessary to do so to know the true potential of employees.

For instance, you have to ask your employees directly what their expectations are about benefits. You can ask them directly or conduct a meeting or survey.

It will help employers to understand their employees’ needs. And according to this, they can craft the benefit packages

Getting the desired benefits will create a sense of empathy in the minds of employees. They will start working more diligently, and ultimately their efficiency will increase with time

User-Friendly Enrollment Processes

Employees perform well in an environment where they believe they are valued. For this, you can allow your employees to manage their benefits through a platform. This will help streamline and simplify the benefits procedure.

By offering these platforms, employers will increase employee participation. It will allow the employee to make informed decisions about their benefits. It increases their active participation as well.

So, for employers, it is best to give your employees the chance to make their own decisions and share valuable thoughts

Regular Reviews and Adjustments

Wanting your employee to stay longer? Then you must offer them something special, that is, employee benefits!

Frequent reviewing and adjustments to your offerings will give you an extra edge over your competitors. Ask your employees what they want, and according to their expectations, design their benefits.

This will create a feeling of harmony and compassion in your employee’s eyes. They will start working more efficiently. However, it will aid organizations as well to work on their benefit offerings to employees.

Conclusion

In conclusion, workers are the assets of every organization. In order to retain them, offer them competitive employee benefits in Abu Dhabi UAE. The benefits that they don’t find anywhere else. However, it is necessary to understand that employers must comply with the law. The UAE government has strict laws when it comes to workers. Any negligence will be encountered as a failure. In resulting to, you have to face severe consequences in the form of penalties. On the other hand, the employee benefits will help both parties to perform well. It helps companies retain top talent while supporting employee well-being.

FAQs

What are gratuity benefits?

In the UAE, the UAE government has launched end-of-service benefits. The employees who served the organization for more than one year are entitled to receive gratuity benefits. It depends on their pay scale and the total duration of employment

What are the impacts of benefits on employee productivity?

It plays a crucial role in employee efficiency and productivity. A satisfied employee always works better than a dissatisfied one. Thanks to the UAE government, who take care of employee well-being. By law, the employees in Abu Dhabi are entitled to receive several benefits. Some of them are:

  • Transportation allowance
  • Paid leaves
  • Gratuity and others

Do the employee benefits differ in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?

To some extent, yes, the UAE government makes sure to grant certain employee benefits to the workers. However, it may differ from city to city. So workers in Dubai have different benefits from those in Abu Dhabi in some areas

What is a housing allowance in Abu Dhabi?

According to the housing allowance law of UAE, Abu Dhabi residents will receive a housing allowance based on their job grade. On the other hand, for non-UAE residents, it is different. They will receive a stipend based on the amount of the rented property annually

How can an employee recruit employees with benefits?

The better you offer, the more you get! It fits well here as well. In order to find and retain top talent, it is essential to provide them with the benefits that retain them. When receiving the benefits that employees heart desire, they ultimately never think of a job switch.

Does an employer need to comply with a law?

Absolutely! You need to comply with the UAE law. The UAE government is strict on the workers’ law. They want to ensure that every individual, whether they are expats or UAE citizens, will get their share.

What are the consequences if you don’t follow UAE employment laws?

Employers who don’t follow employment laws closely will face severe consequences. They will face penalties and even jail if the negligence is severe.
